keyPoints.en: A nation-state = sovereign country + people with a shared identity + one government + clear territory.
keyPoints.bm: Negara bangsa = negara berdaulat + rakyat berkongsi identiti + satu kerajaan + wilayah yang jelas.

keyPoints.en: Early kingdoms in our region: Kedah Tua, Funan, Champa, Srivijaya, Majapahit and later Melaka.
keyPoints.bm: Kerajaan awal di rantau kita: Kedah Tua, Funan, Champa, Srivijaya, Majapahit dan kemudian Melaka.

keyPoints.en: Most grew near rivers and the sea so they could control trade.
keyPoints.bm: Kebanyakannya berkembang di tepi sungai dan laut untuk menguasai perdagangan.

keyPoints.en: The waadat between Sang Sapurba and Demang Lebar Daun set the ruler–people relationship: justice for loyalty.
keyPoints.bm: Waadat antara Sang Sapurba dan Demang Lebar Daun menetapkan hubungan raja–rakyat: keadilan dibalas kesetiaan.

tip.en: Remember the four basics with “K-W-R-K”: Kedaulatan, Wilayah, Rakyat, Kerajaan.
tip.bm: Ingat empat asas dengan “K-W-R-K”: Kedaulatan, Wilayah, Rakyat, Kerajaan.

keyPoints.en: Sovereignty: the ruler had daulat; rebelling was derhaka.
keyPoints.bm: Kedaulatan: raja mempunyai daulat; menentang dianggap derhaka.

keyPoints.en: Territory: a clear area under the ruler, including vassal states.
keyPoints.bm: Wilayah: kawasan jelas di bawah raja, termasuk negeri naungan.

keyPoints.en: Government: ruler helped by officials; laws such as Hukum Kanun Melaka.
keyPoints.bm: Kerajaan: raja dibantu pembesar; undang-undang seperti Hukum Kanun Melaka.

keyPoints.en: Identity: Malay language, Islam and royal regalia (nobat, payung kuning).
keyPoints.bm: Identiti: bahasa Melayu, Islam dan alat kebesaran diraja (nobat, payung kuning).

question.en: Give one symbol of the ruler's sovereignty.

answer.en: The nobat (royal drums) or the yellow umbrella.

keyPoints.en: Melaka was founded by Parameswara around 1400 and became a great trading port.
keyPoints.bm: Melaka dibuka oleh Parameswara sekitar 1400 dan menjadi pelabuhan perdagangan yang hebat.

keyPoints.en: Pembesar Empat Lipatan: Bendahara, Penghulu Bendahari, Temenggung, Laksamana.
keyPoints.bm: Pembesar Empat Lipatan: Bendahara, Penghulu Bendahari, Temenggung, Laksamana.

keyPoints.en: Syahbandar managed foreign traders at the port.
keyPoints.bm: Syahbandar mengurus pedagang asing di pelabuhan.

keyPoints.en: Written laws: Hukum Kanun Melaka (land) and Undang-undang Laut Melaka (sea).
keyPoints.bm: Undang-undang bertulis: Hukum Kanun Melaka (darat) dan Undang-undang Laut Melaka (laut).

keyPoints.en: Melaka spread Islam and the Malay language across the region.
keyPoints.bm: Melaka menyebarkan Islam dan bahasa Melayu ke seluruh rantau.

tip.en: In essays, pair each strength with evidence (a name, a law or an official).
tip.bm: Dalam esei, pasangkan setiap keunggulan dengan bukti (nama, undang-undang atau pembesar).
